sorular.soru: The Medical Report Format for Seafarers is filled/completed by:
siklar: By the Captain and also the hospital/doctor ashore,

sorular.soru: The most modern kind of lifeboat, dropping or falling into the sea and which is covered, is a/an:

The M/V Yıldız got loaded at Port of Izmir with dried fruits and left for Lısbon. When arrived at the Port of Lisbon, she was detained because the Master’s Certificate was Master Certificate not Unlimited Master Certificate. The detention was attributed to the incompliance with the requirements of............................
The opening to the hold from the upper deck is called a/an …………………………………………………..
The publication in which the medical codes is found is ........................
The purpose of a “Notice of Readiness” is to ……………………………………………………………….
siklar: inform the related party that the vessel is in all respects ready to commence loading/ discharging operation.
note that the charter is ready to sign the relevant document.
notice that the parties have agreed on the readiness.
specify the full account of the nature of a charter party.
inform the master that the consignee is ready to receive the goods.

sorular.soru: The rudder fitted at the stern of the ship is turned by a ………………………………………………….
The starboard bow is the area................................
siklar: on the right side of the stem.
on the right side of the stern.
on the left side of the stem.
on the left side of the midship line.
on either side of the stern.

sorular.soru: The space between the holds and the bottom of the hull contains ……….. used for ballast water and fuel.
The term “vessel” is different from the term “ship” in that the term vessel is used for...........................
siklar: some floating craft used for sport activities only.

sorular.soru: “The weather was supposed to be nice today, but we were almost frozen to death while doing the ship’s maintenance.” can be expressed as .....................................
siklar: The weather was expected to be cold today but it is not
The weather was not very cold today as it was before
Although everyone hoped for a cold day it turned out to be nice
The weather was terribly cold although it had been expected to be good
The day was so nice and warm just as we had expected before

sorular.soru: The vessel which has the right of way is known as ..................................
There are certain medicines on board which you can only use when:
siklar: Captain orders you to do so,
You have medical advice by radio,
The ill/injured person wants you to do so,
The shipowner gives you instructions to do so.

sorular.soru: There is a vessel obstructing your movements.
siklar: İlerde hareketlerinizi engelleyen bir gemi var
İlerde hareketinize kasteden bir gemi var
İlerde sizi takip eden bir gemi var
İlerde sizin hareketinizi bekleyen bir gemi var
İlerde sizinle ilgili hareketli bir gemi var

sorular.soru: “There is no doubt that the scope of a pilot’s duties have over the years been clearly defined. That he has exclusive control and conduct of the ship is seldom disputed, but this is very different from having command of the ship.” It is implied in the above mentioned quotation that ...............................................
siklar: the scope of a pilot’s duties has ever been doubtful.
no rule has ever clearly defined as pilot’s duties.
a pilot has the conduct of the ship he is in charge of navigating.
a pilot has both conduct and command of the ship he is in charge of.
a pilot’s exclusive control and conduct of a ship has been a point of dispute

sorular.soru: There shall be clear instructions relating to the operating of the system. Correct translation of this sentence into Turkish is;
siklar: Sistemin çalışmasına ilişkin açık talimatlar bulunacaktır.
Sistem üzerindeki açık talimatlara göre çalıştırılır.
Sistemin çalışması açık talimatlar olmasıyla ilgilidir.

sorular.soru: “This is to certify that before/after loading/discharging, all cargo tanks were inspected and found empty and dry”. This is an example of.....................................

“This is to notify you officially that vessel ………. under my command has arrived in your port on ……. at …………. hours and is ready to discharge/load cargo of ……… kilos of …….. as per clauses and conditions of the covering charter-party. Master”. This is an example of a ……………..
